title: Moonlit Meadow
concept: Premium illustrated cover for a 33-pattern US-terms crochet flower and bouquet bundle.
artwork_description: A graceful upright meadow bouquet of layered wildflowers and foliage rises from the lower third of the page. A small crescent moon medallion crowns the bouquet above the title, with faint powder-blue and lavender blue-hour washes behind it. The title sits in a calm upper-middle area, followed by the short subtitle and a small US-terms note, framed by sparse botanical flourishes.
generation_prompt: Cover artwork: upright illustrated meadow flower bouquet in the lower third, including rose, lavender, blush, sage and small powder-blue wildflower accents; small crescent moon medallion centred above bouquet; title text exactly “MOONLIT MEADOW”; subtitle exactly “Crochet Bouquet Pattern Bundle”; small line exactly “33 patterns • US terms”; delicate botanical dividers and faint twilight meadow wash, with spacious editorial title hierarchy.
production_notes: Verify all cover text exactly: “MOONLIT MEADOW”, “Crochet Bouquet Pattern Bundle”, and “33 patterns • US terms”. Keep the moon medallion as the unmistakable visual hook. No crochet tools, yarn, stitch diagrams or finished crochet items in the illustration. Supply as the illustrated cover artwork component.

title: Patterns & Bouquet Planning

instructions: Choose your blooms, then plan your bouquet.
artwork_description: A centred, highly legible two-column contents list is surrounded by light botanical corner sprays and a restrained crescent divider. A lower planning strip offers three small labelled bouquet recipes with tiny painted flower icons: Soft Dawn, Meadow Dusk and Moonlit Garden. Decorative flowers remain sparse so the complete list is easy to read.

title: Flowers for Ever
concept: A decorative divider and keepsake motif page for the bundle, suitable as a cover sheet, pinboard print or section separator.
artwork_description: A tranquil full-page botanical arrangement forms a loose oval wreath around a central crescent moon medallion. The wreath combines meadow blooms, rosebuds, lavender stems, wispy foliage and a few tiny powder-blue blossoms, leaving a generous cream centre for the short sentiment. A very faint meadow horizon sits low on the page.
generation_prompt: Decorative botanical motif page; loose oval wreath of meadow blooms, rosebuds, lavender stems, small daisies, wispy sage foliage and tiny powder-blue blossoms surrounding a central crescent moon medallion; central text exactly “FLOWERS FOR EVER”; subtle low meadow-horizon accent; spacious calm composition with no practical pattern instructions.
production_notes: Verify the central sentiment exactly as “FLOWERS FOR EVER” in UK spelling. Maintain generous cream space and restrained coverage so this page can be printed as a decorative separator or display print. No crochet hooks, yarn balls, stitch diagrams or finished crochet pieces.
